claims.claim: Nominal state stores a quaternion; error orientation is a minimal three-vector; total state 19 stored versus 18 error entries with gravity
Local quaternion error right multiplies; global error left multiplies; coordinate and multiplication conventions must be consistent
Local error dynamics have velocity-orientation block −R[a_m−b_a]× and angular block −[ω_m−b_g]×
Zero error mean does not permit skipping covariance prediction
H is derivative with respect to error state; a 4×3 quaternion composition block enters the chain rule
Reset covariance via GPGᵀ; local rotational reset I−½[δθ_hat]×, global I+½[δθ_hat]×
Sample-held measurement noise and unsampled continuous perturbations have different Δt scaling in the tutorial convention
claims.conditions: Discrete sampled variance is not interchangeable with continuous noise spectral density; general noise discretization may require transition-weighted integration

claims.claim: Rotated noise can lose R only for isotropic covariance
Closed forms assume A constant over interval; RK transition integration handles A(t); truncated blocks trade accuracy and cost
This is a tutorial, not a new empirical benchmark; proposed numerical tests and learned interfaces are reader recommendations
